result.reason: The operative language reaches the preferred position: Client retains ownership of its content, IP and Customer Data without joint ownership; deliverables and work product created specifically for Client are assigned to Client; and TrueLink retains pre-existing or independently developed IP while granting a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free licence to embedded TrueLink IP. The existing Interface ownership and Credit Data licence are preserved. The changes are appropriately limited. Drafting is generally professional, though the inherited phrase “any or its intellectual property” and the awkward construction “in which TrueLink hereby grants” should be corrected for clarity.
